lines.text: Many learners say: My dog is very sensible.
Better: My dog is very sensitive.
Sensible means you have good sense.

data.why: Sensible means you have good sense.

quiz.stem: He cries easily. He is very ___.

native.tip: En inglés, “sensible” es “sensato”. Nuestro “sensible” se dice “sensitive.”

en.tip: In English, “sensible” means “sensato.” For “sensible” as in feelings, say “sensitive.”
